title: Earthy Light Mexican Chicken Tacos
description: A one-pot Mexican dish featuring herbal flavors, light texture, and coco sugar, cooked in a traditional molcajete vessel, with a dash of creativity and spherification technique.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the molcajete over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the chicken breast pieces and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the coco sugar, taco seasoning, lime juice, water, salt, and pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10-12 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Stir in the chopped cilantro and cook for an additional minute.
Use a spherification technique to create small, bouncy balls of the chicken mixture.
Serve the earthy light Mexican chicken tacos in the molcajete, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
